」

今までとは逆、決して離れないよう鎖を掴み、
「
二度と、この世に顔を出すんじゃねえ……！」

pages.en:
——If there is no way for me to survive, then at least I can keep him from ever getting out…!

“To hell with you. You're——”

I wind the chain deep around my arm.

The reverse of everything I have done until now: I seize it so that it can never come loose.

“——never showing your face in this world again…!”

I stop resisting and cast myself into the black aperture.

“You foo——have you lost your miiiiind…!?”

We tumble downward.

My body dissolving around me, I fall without end into the darkness.

pages.ja:
容赦なくこの身を蝕む黒い泥。
そうしてカラを剥がされ、衛宮士郎という魂だけになって、深い底へ落ちていく。

pages.en:
The black mud devours my body without mercy.

My shell is stripped away until nothing remains but the soul called Shirou Emiya, falling into the deepest abyss.

pages.ja:
その落下があまりにも長すぎたからか。
いつしか落ちているのではなく昇っているような錯覚の後。
黒い、杯のような太陽に呑みこまれた。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Perhaps the descent simply lasted too long.

At some point, falling began to feel like rising.

Then a chalice-shaped black sun swallowed me whole.
